_note: Starter questions and gates for one limma contrast. Written for human or mouse transcriptomics: edit the option descriptions, and the gene names in them, for other organisms or data types. Thresholds are design choices, not tuned values.

questions.text: Which description best fits the top up- and down-regulated features of this contrast, given the comparison in `unit.definition`?

options.response to the comparison: The features are what the comparison in `unit.definition` would plausibly change, or they form a coherent biological response to it.
options.sex difference: The list is dominated by sex-linked genes such as XIST, RPS4Y1, DDX3Y, KDM5D, or UTY.
options.sample handling or stress: The list is dominated by immediate-early, heat-shock, or hypoxia genes such as FOS, JUN, EGR1, or HSPA1A.
options.cell-type composition: The list is dominated by marker genes of one cell type, which suggests the groups differ in which cells are present.
options.no recognisable pattern: The features share no program, or the identifiers cannot be recognised.

questions.text: Do the features in `unit.top_features.up` belong to one recognisable biological program or pathway?
Name the program of the up-regulated features in at most six words. Answer 'none' if there is no single program.
Do the features in `unit.top_features.down` belong to one recognisable biological program or pathway?
Name the program of the down-regulated features in at most six words. Answer 'none' if there is no single program.
In one or two sentences, name the features from this unit that your answers rest on.

gates._note: For each blocking check, the statuses that send the unit to review. A warning blocks for replicates and for the p-value distribution, because both mean the hit list may not be what it seems. A batch warning (batch balanced but not modelled, or not declared) is recorded and does not block.
